notes.title: Flappy Arms version 1.0.1 release
notes.notes:
Flappy Arms v1.0.1 includes fixes for the following bugs
[list]
[*] The player's score display  is now 87.3% more accurate!!!
don't worry, the scores saved to the leaderboards were correct ;) 
[*] The spectator camera has been adjusted to prevent clipping
[*] The spectator camera won't let you peek under the scenery anymore*
[*] The size of the gap between buildings should now reset properly when restarting
(Thanks Vadon!)

*most of the time... probably
[/list]
